notes: Counts retain published versus release-listing distinctions.
No actual new train/validation/test assignment is claimed.
All download URLs are leads, not proof of complete current binary access.

datasets.name: Sood 999-frame macro stack
datasets.signal_and_RAW_status: 999 CR3 paths listed; 999 8-bit sRGB TIFF paths listed
datasets.reference_semantics: Stacked preview is demonstration, not calibrated truth
datasets.original_split: HF 'train' labels frames; not an independent train split
datasets.access_evidence: Direct API/card/license/checksum text acquired; images not fetched
datasets.limitations: One scene; contiguous prefixes change focus range; RAW/TIFF grids differ; six-minute capture may include motion
datasets.split_group: All 999 frames, RAW/TIFF variants and derivatives in one group

datasets.name: Amber spider optical focal stacks
datasets.scene_count_and_status: ZIP contains unknown stack count; two same-sized upload entries
datasets.reference_semantics: Do not use confocal CZI as optical all-focus truth
datasets.access_evidence: Creator metadata/listing acquired; two optical ZIP entries have equal size and equal provider MD5; interiors not inspected
datasets.limitations: Provider metadata confirms duplicate optical ZIP entries; distinct confocal modality; preprocessing; shared specimen
datasets.split_group: Specimen/amber piece/optical variants grouped; confocal separate modality

datasets.name: MFI-WHU
datasets.signal_and_RAW_status: Derived from full-clear public images; archive not decoded
datasets.reference_semantics: Original clear image under synthetic blur convention; not optical macro truth
datasets.rights_evidence: MIT repo; underlying public-image terms unresolved
datasets.limitations: Public original images unspecified; hard-mask blur may omit optical occlusion; subsets vary
datasets.split_group: Original full-clear source image and derivatives grouped

datasets.name: EDMF
datasets.scene_count_and_status: 1000 pairs in paper; current tree 950 A + 1000 B
datasets.original_split: Paper first 500 pairs train / remaining 500 test
datasets.rights_evidence: Dataset CC BY 4.0 explicitly stated in original paper
datasets.access_evidence: Complete nontruncated tree acquired; missing-pair audit saved
datasets.limitations: Release lacks 50 A counterparts; automatic camera settings; registration borders; ID order is not session independence
datasets.split_group: Original scene/session/camera groups; preserve paper holdout IDs

datasets.name: HRMFF
datasets.resolution_and_status: high-resolution label; exact decoded dimensions not checked
datasets.reference_semantics: PDRFuse result metrics are not truth
datasets.rights_evidence: Apache 2.0 repo LICENSE; capture ancestry not separately verified
datasets.access_evidence: Complete author tree verifies 40 source JPEG paths
datasets.limitations: Only pairs; source rights/metadata sparse; no high-bit-depth guarantee
datasets.split_group: Physical scene and related images grouped

datasets.name: Mobile Depth
datasets.scene_count_and_status: Original count not verified in this review
datasets.reference_semantics: Depth estimates/AiF composites are not independent exact truth
datasets.rights_evidence: No terms located on creator download page
datasets.access_evidence: Creator page and archive route inspected; binary not fetched
datasets.limitations: Not true highmagnification macro; original counts and license need intake
datasets.split_group: Capture scene/session and calibrated/unregistered variants grouped

datasets.name: DefocusNet / FoD500
datasets.resolution_and_status: not independently checked from image headers
datasets.reference_semantics: Depth file and rendered blur; AiF reference availability not verified
datasets.original_split: First 400 train / remaining 100 test per README
datasets.rights_evidence: MIT code; external object/environment asset terms separate
datasets.access_evidence: Author README and 232850362-byte archive metadata read
datasets.limitations: Phone-like 2.9mm f/1 camera and metre-scale scene; 5 frames; Thingi10K assets
datasets.split_group: Mesh/HDRI/texture/source scene and render variants grouped

datasets.name: InfinigenDefocus
datasets.scene_count_and_status: 200 rendered views; 1,000 fixed-aperture stacks by archive layout
datasets.reference_semantics: Provider all-in-focus RGB render at the same view; native rendered depth available
datasets.original_split: Hugging Face train split; no benchmark split assigned
datasets.access_evidence: Publisher revision, archive SHA-256, byte size and ZIP member layout verified
datasets.limitations: Indoor synthetic domain; scene ancestry and asset reuse require audit
datasets.split_group: Group all views and apertures sharing a scene seed
